Variants.Content: Entry The "Seven Kingdoms" is the general name for Westeros under the Iron Throne's rule, and does not always strictly correspond to seven equally sized lands. It originates from the memories of the kingdoms before the Conquest and the later addition of Dorne; the North, the Riverlands, the Vale, the Westerlands, the Reach, the Stormlands, Dorne Iron Throne brings them into the same set of allegiances, taxes, marriage alliances, and laws of war, but it cannot erase the differences left by rivers, mountains, old gods, the Seven, and local families.

Entry Seven Kingdoms Commonwealth of the Seven Kingdoms: The "Seven Kingdoms" is the general name for Westeros under the Iron Throne's rule, and does not always strictly correspond to seven equally sized lands. It originates from the memories of the kingdoms before the Conquest and the later addition of Dorne; the North, the Riverlands, the Vale, the Westerlands, the Reach, the Stormlands, Dorne They start by asking who is obligated, who is protected, and who will seek justice after a breach of contract.
